selector.rationale: Histologic examination revealed eroded surface mucosa with reactive hyperplastic glands and marked expansion of the lamina propria by a dense mixed inflammatory infiltrate with basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions positive on von Kossa and periodic acid–Schiff stains, characteristic of Malakoplakia

rejected.label: Whipple disease
rejected.why: Negative for organisms on fungal and acid-fast stains

rejected.label: Graft-versus-host disease
rejected.why: No mention of graft-versus-host disease symptoms or history

rejected.label: Chemotherapy-induced colitis
rejected.why: Colonoscopy showed polyps and erythematous mucosa, not typical of chemotherapy-induced colitis

rejected.label: Inflammatory bowel disease
rejected.why: Lack of abdominal pain, weight loss, and other typical inflammatory bowel disease symptoms
